sections.description:
🚀 AI RSS Rewriter – The Ultimate Content Automation Solution! Transform RSS feeds into unique, SEO-optimized articles using cutting-edge AI technologies from OpenAI.

✨ Why Choose AI RSS Rewriter?

AI RSS Rewriter is the most powerful content automation tool that enables you to:
– 📰 Automatically import content from RSS feeds
– 🤖 Rewrite articles using GPT-5 and DALL-E 3
– 🎯 Create unique content without plagiarism
– 📈 Improve SEO rankings automatically
– 💰 Control AI processing costs

🎯 Perfect For:

  • 📰 News & Media Websites – Automatic content updates
  • 📝 Bloggers & Content Marketers – Scale content production
  • 🏢 SEO Agencies – Manage client content
  • 🛒 Affiliate Sites – Import product information
  • 📊 Content Aggregators – Process large volumes of information

⚠️ Important: External Service Dependency

This plugin requires an OpenAI API key for AI functionality. Without a valid API key, only basic RSS importing (Simple Mode) is available.

AI features include:
– Content rewriting
– Image generation
– SEO optimization

Please ensure you have a valid OpenAI API key before using AI features.

🔥 Key Features

🤖 AI Power

  • 🔄 AI Content Rewriting – Transform RSS content into unique articles using GPT-5 and GPT-4o models
  • 🎨 DALL-E 3 Image Generation – Automatically create contextual images for articles
  • 🧠 Smart Model Selection – Automatically choose optimal AI models based on content complexity
  • ⚙️ Custom AI Prompts – Create, test, and manage custom prompts for different content types

💰 Cost Control

  • 📊 Budget Management – Set daily spending limits with real-time cost tracking
  • 💡 Smart Savings – Automatic model selection can reduce costs by 40-60%

🚀 Performance & Optimization

  • 🖼️ Image Optimization – WebP conversion and compression for better performance
  • ⚡ Speed Optimization – Optimized database queries and caching
  • 📱 Modern Interface – Clean, responsive design with real-time statistics

📝 Content & SEO

  • 📄 Content Extraction – Extract full article content when RSS feeds provide only summaries
  • 📅 Flexible Post Dating – Use original RSS dates or current parsing time
  • 🎯 SEO Optimization – Auto-generate meta descriptions and tags
  • ✅ WordPress Standards – Fully compliant with WordPress coding standards

⚙️ Processing Modes

🔧 Simple Mode

Perfect for beginners or limited budgets
* 📥 Basic RSS importing without AI processing
* 🆓 Free mode (no OpenAI API required)
* ⚡ Fast content import
* 📝 Preserve original text

🤖 AI Mode

Full artificial intelligence power
* 🔄 AI content rewriting
* 🎨 Automatic image generation
* 🎯 SEO optimization
* 💰 AI cost control

🧠 Supported AI Models

🏆 GPT-5 (Premium Quality)

  • Best quality content rewriting
  • High accuracy and creativity
  • Recommended for important content

⚖️ GPT-5 Mini (Recommended Balance)

  • Optimal balance of quality and speed
  • Cost-effective option with good quality
  • Perfect for regular use

⚡ GPT-5 Nano (Fastest)

  • Fastest processing
  • Most economical option
  • Suitable for mass processing

🔄 GPT-4o Mini (Fallback)

  • Fallback option when other models unavailable
  • Stable performance
  • Compatible with all features

🎯 Perfect For

📰 News & Media Websites

  • Automatic content aggregation from multiple sources
  • Fast news updates
  • Create unique content from RSS feeds

📝 Content Marketers

  • Scale content production
  • Automate content strategy
  • Save time on article writing

✍️ Bloggers

  • Automated content with unique approach
  • Expand blog topics
  • Constant flow of fresh content

🏢 SEO Agencies

  • Manage client content
  • Automate SEO optimization
  • Scale services

🛒 Affiliate Sites

  • Import product information
  • Automatically create product descriptions
  • SEO-optimized content for sales

📋 System Requirements

💻 Technical Requirements

  • WordPress: 5.0 or higher
  • PHP: 7.4 or higher (PHP 8.0+ recommended)
  • GD Extension: for image optimization
  • Memory: minimum 128MB (256MB recommended)

🔑 OpenAI API (Required for AI Features)

  • Get API Key: platform.openai.com/api-keys
  • AI Rewriting: requires GPT-4 or GPT-4o models
  • Image Generation: requires DALL-E 3 access
  • Without API Key: only Simple Mode available (basic RSS import)

💰 Estimated Costs

  • Content Rewriting: $0.01-0.05 per article
  • Image Generation: $0.04-0.08 per image
  • SEO Tags: $0.001-0.005 per article
  • Smart Model Selection: can reduce costs by 40-60%

⚠️ Important

  • API key must have sufficient credits and proper permissions
  • Without OpenAI API key, only basic RSS import is available
  • All data is sent to OpenAI according to their privacy policy

Legal Information:

User Control:

* You control what content is sent by managing your RSS feeds
* You can delete generated content at any time

* Stores API keys encrypted in your WordPress database

For support, documentation, and feature requests, please visit the plugin support forum or contact the developer.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “AI RSS Rewriter”
  4. Click “Install Now” then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin files
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ai-rss-rewriter/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

Setup

  1. Go to AI RSS Rewriter in your admin menu
  2. Choose processing mode (Simple or AI)
  3. If using AI mode, enter your OpenAI API key
  4. Configure budget limits and processing preferences
  5. Add your first RSS feed
  6. Customize AI prompts if desired
  7. Start processing feeds automatically or manually
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

Only for AI features. You can use Simple mode for basic RSS importing without AI processing.

How much does AI processing cost?

Costs depend on usage:
– Content rewriting: $0.01-0.05 per article
– Image generation: $0.04-0.08 per image
– Tags/SEO: $0.001-0.005 per article
Smart model selection can reduce costs by 40-60%.

Can I customize AI prompts?

Yes! The plugin includes a prompts manager where you can create, test, and manage custom prompts with variables like {title}, {content}, and {categories}.

What image formats are supported?

The plugin generates images with DALL-E 3 and can optimize them to WebP, JPEG, or PNG formats for better performance.

Is it compatible with other plugins?

Yes, AI RSS Rewriter works with popular plugins including Yoast SEO, RankMath, WooCommerce, and major page builders.

How do I control costs?

Set daily budget limits, use smart model selection, and monitor real-time cost tracking in the dashboard.
